text:
QUOTE: "`_bindings.py` is auto-generated by `scripts/gen_bindings.py` from `entropic.h`. Pre-commit runs `gen-bindings --check`, so the committed file can't drift from the header."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that a pre-commit check (`gen-bindings --check`) stops the generated bindings from drifting from the header. It doesn't say outright that the check re-runs the generator and diffs. That is what a `--check` mode on a generator means, so the substance is there.
